entities.summary: Colonel Fielding Hudson Garrison, MD was an acclaimed medical historian, bibliographer, and librarian of medicine. Garrison's An Introduction to the History of Medicine (1913) is a landmark text in this field. Fielding Hudson Garrison was a journalists & chroniclers from Washington, D.C. (1870-11-05, Washington, D.C.–1935-04-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
